cohort: All singleton live births in Iceland between 1997 and 2015, totaling 80,130 individuals, were included.
finding: The overall cesarean birth rate in Iceland did not significantly change between 1997 and 2015, but specific subgroups showed changes, notably a rise in prelabor cesareans for preterm births and multiparous women over 35 years.
mod_finding: While the overall cesarean birth rate remained stable, there was an increase in prelabor cesareans for preterm births and multiparous women over 35 years, alongside a decrease in intrapartum cesareans for multiparas.
gest_age: All gestational ages, analyzed in groups including preterm (<37 weeks) and early-term (37-38 weeks).
